name: cortext
description: Cortext — the Claude Code skin for the cortext coordination capability. /substrate-setup wires HTTP-only hooks — SessionStart (binding-rule index, inbox count) plus Stop/UserPromptSubmit inbox checks at the session seams — a per-machine substrate MCP server, a versioned conventions fragment, and baseline AgentRules. Gracefully degrades when server-side recall is unavailable. Optional agent-identity signing (SUBSTRATE_AGENT_KEY_PATH/KEY_ID) gives per-project write attribution, the agent mailbox, and identity-gated read postures.
